observations: Single photo shows a tire from a face-on angle, revealing only the tread pattern and tread face.
No sidewall markings (brand, size, DOT code) are visible in this shot.
Tread shows moderate wear with some uneven wear patches and surface scuffing.
Two other tires are partially visible in the background, suggesting a dealer's used-tire stock.
Watermark reads 'POSTED ON JIJI N.J VENTURE', consistent with a marketplace listing, not proof of the item itself.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only the tread face; no sidewall text with size markings is visible.
Photo 0 shows visible wear consistent with a used tire, but no way to confirm origin, age, or grade of 'tokunbo' claim.

risks.risk: Actual tire size may not match the claimed 295/40 R20, affecting fitment and price.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the sidewall showing the size imprint.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed size, treated as generic used tire until size is verified

risks.risk: Brand and model are unknown, which strongly affects resale value.
risks.proof: A clear sidewall photo showing brand name and model.

risks.risk: Tire age (production date) unknown; old rubber can be unsafe regardless of tread depth.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the DOT code on the sidewall.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown age, worst case treated as old stock

risks.risk: Hidden sidewall damage (cracks, bulges, repairs) not visible from the tread-only angle.
risks.proof: Photos of both sidewalls of the tire.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly damaged, worst case assumes sidewall defect

risks.risk: Tread depth cannot be precisely measured from the photo alone.
risks.proof: A photo with a tread depth gauge or ruler placed in the groove.
risks.if_unproven: priced as low tread depth / near replacement threshold

proof_requests: Clear photo of the sidewall showing brand, model, and size markings.
Close-up photo of the DOT code for manufacture date.
Photos of both sidewalls to check for cracks, bulges, or repairs.
A tread depth measurement photo with a gauge or ruler.
response.reason: The single photo only shows the tread face with no visible brand, size, or DOT markings, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without a sidewall shot confirming the claimed size and condition.
